metadata.title: Ayvago
metadata.description: Retro action, casual and puzzle games in one place. Free to play in your browser.
metadata.gameDescriptionSuffix: Play free in your browser on Ayvago.

home.tagline: Retro action, casual and puzzle games in one place.

profile.title: Profile and settings
profile.unavailable: Accounts are not available on this site right now.
profile.guestStart: No account needed to play: press Play on any game and you start as a guest.
profile.deletedNotice: Your account and all of its data were deleted.
profile.bestsEmpty: Finish a game to record your first personal best.
profile.characterHelp: Games with a hero, like Jetpack Rush, play with the character you choose here, in solo runs and online matches. All characters are free.
profile.characterNone: No character chosen yet: games use their own.
profile.settingsSync: Your avatar, character, theme and language are saved to your account and follow you to every device.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
profile.exportBody: Download everything Ayvago stores about you (profile, favorites, recently played games and best scores) as a JSON file.
profile.exportFailed: The download failed. Please try again.
profile.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your profile, favorites, recently played games, best scores, leaderboard places and votes, and your sign-in. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
profile.usernameGuest: Sign in with Google to choose your own username.
profile.usernameRules: 3–20 characters: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter. You can choose a new name once every {days} days.

usernameErrors.invalid: Use 3–20 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
usernameErrors.reserved: This name is reserved. Please choose another one.
usernameErrors.offensive: This name is not allowed. Please choose another one.
usernameErrors.taken: This name is already taken. Please choose another one.
usernameErrors.cooldown: You can choose a new name on {date}.
usernameErrors.registered-only: Sign in with Google to choose your own username.
usernameErrors.generic: The username could not be saved. Please try again.

appCheck.title: App Check
appCheck.intro: App Check lets the score and vote functions tell the real Ayvago site from scripts. While monitoring, unverified calls are still accepted; enforcing refuses them. Switching takes effect within a minute and can be undone here.
appCheck.share: Last 24 hours: {verified} of {sessions} game sessions verified ({percent}).
appCheck.ready: Ready: at least 95% of the last day's sessions were verified.
appCheck.notReadyHint: Not ready yet: enforcing needs at least 20 sessions in the last day, 95% of them verified. If the share stays near 0%, the App Check site key is not set up (see the Phase 2 setup checklist).
appCheck.confirmForce: Confirm: unverified players will be refused
appCheck.monitoring: Back to monitoring; unverified calls are accepted again.
appCheck.notReady: Not enough verified sessions yet to enforce safely.

install.title: Install Ayvago
install.body: Play from your home screen: full screen, one tap away.
install.iosBody: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.edgeHint: Edge may open its App info screen first: allow “Home screen shortcuts”, come back and tap Install again. In Chrome it installs in one tap.
install.manualBody: Open your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. If Ayvago is already installed, open it from your home screen.

online.playWithFriendHint: Create a room and send the link to a friend. You play against each other, each on your own device.

online.peerAway: {name} left the room. The match continues when they come back.
